realizes.rationale: The real bound-tree schema adapter prepares consumable historical row/proof addresses without role/UI launch. _carried now checks owner path, side, revision, row/attempt/proof/record together; the independent invariant-path substitution is unresolved while the valid row consumer and foreign-comparison refusal pass. Bounds and collection missing/omission states are retained. This is not evidence that the separate partial-index/cache scenario required by F16 was supplied.

The previously missing owner evidence is now supplied: real bound Git tree with malformed omitted record creates partial SQLite index; valid records/proofs remain usable; emitted packet carries measured partial state and absence-unknown limitation. Deleting the exact-tree cache and changing checkout contents rebuilds identical historical wire/packet. Lost history and explicitly injected cache-build failure preserve owner reason without inventing complete/empty data; independent code-side reading still works. prepare_evidence consumes real opened ReviewTrees measured states, not caller-invented complete flags. Prior maximum/two-size/restart/cancellation/race evidence remains credited; no early installed/UI requirement added.
